name: Alanya
title: Holidays in Alanya
intro: A Turkish Riviera resort under a castle-topped headland, with Cleopatra Beach, boat trips to sea caves and the Taurus mountains behind. Here's what Alanya is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: Alanya harbour with a lighthouse, and the castle hill and town rising behind

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 2 hrs ahead of the UK (3 in winter)

facts.label: Entry
facts.value: No visa for up to 90 days

facts_note: Antalya airport is about 2 hours away; the small Gazipaşa airport is closer but has fewer flights. Your passport needs at least 150 days left on it when you arrive. Check entry rules and the latest travel advice on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May, June, September and October are the best months, hot and sunny with a warm sea. July and August are very hot and humid. The season runs long, and late October is still beach weather. Winter is mild but wet, and quieter.

things.name: Cleopatra Beach
things.blurb: A long sandy beach below the castle, with clear water.

things.name: Alanya Castle
things.blurb: Seljuk walls wrap the headland. Take the cable car up for views along the coast.

things.name: Red Tower
things.blurb: An octagonal 13th-century tower guarding the harbour.

things.name: Boat trip to the caves
things.blurb: Round the headland to Damlataş, the Pirates' Cave and the Lovers' Cave.

things.name: Dim River
things.blurb: Riverside restaurants on platforms over the water, in the cool hills.

things.name: Sapadere Canyon
things.blurb: A walkway through a narrow gorge of waterfalls and pools.

faqs.question: Is Alanya cheap?
faqs.answer: Compared with most Mediterranean resorts, yes, especially for food and all-inclusive hotels.

faqs.question: Which airport is best for Alanya?
faqs.answer: Antalya has the most flights and is about 2 hours by transfer. Gazipaşa is only 40 minutes away, but routes are limited.

faqs.question: Is the sea warm in Alanya in October?
faqs.answer: Yes, around 25°C, and days are usually still in the mid 20s.

faqs.question: Is Alanya good for a beach holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cleopatra Beach and the long beaches east of town are sandy, with calm water.
